assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and exertional dyspnea in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries.
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10).
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmic etiologies contributing to the patient's symptoms.
The service is medically necessary to determine whether an arrhythmia is responsible for the patient's palpitations and dyspnea.
